made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/bano-sheet-make.js, from bano-set.html (window.BANO.E) and the design of El baño (the orchestrator's p9-spec, general rules and section bano). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 66. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the back wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 66 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.3: the small stool Carmen stands on; z 0.8: the shelves' tops and the sink's top; z 0.4: the stool's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): its bottom middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX); a grown-up (abuelo) draws 51 rows of a 56-row canvas, a child 41 of 44 (the raincoat child 43: the hood), their lowest canvas rows empty; abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30, 50 rows drawn; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); Canelo standing mkPerro (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge, 30 columns of ink (his box is 28); a small thing: see spot. The stool under Carmen (12 x 7): its top row on her feet's row sy, its middle column on sx, so its bottom edge is on the floor point of her spot (sy + 7). A towel over a head (16 x 10): its top row on the top row of the child's drawing, its middle column on his. The gauge's three bars (8 x 3): centred on the gauge, 3 px apart. Nobody is drawn turned: whoever stands in the shower or at the sink faces us
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the shower's low front wall hides the lower rows of whoever stands in the shower, the sink and the stool hide the legs of whoever stands behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El pedido's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) and .3 for Canelo (as El calendario; open point)
